response.sql: SELECT mj.college, SUM(i.amount) as total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(i2.amount) FROM income i2 JOIN member m2 ON i2.link_to_member = m2.member_id JOIN major mj2 ON m2.link_to_major = mj2.major_id) as fraction_of_total FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY mj.college ORDER BY mj.college
